page_structure: Very different from Barbarian/Bard. The page adds a 3-spell list to EVERY cleric domain (core-book domains and new 3rd-party domains alike), plus a flat "Cleric Spells (All Domains)" list usable regardless of domain, plus a short "Cleric Rituals" section. Individual domain-specific spells within a domain's 3-spell list are NOT individually Source-tagged — only domain SECTIONS carry an explicit Source tag when the domain itself isn't from DATP (this book pioneered the domain-spell-list concept, so untagged/DATP is the default and only deviations get an explicit tag). The page also has a compact summary table (domain name -> comma list of its 3ish spell names) near the top that is INTERNALLY STALE relative to the page's own detailed spell write-ups further down — 3+ confirmed cases where the summary table still shows an old spell name (e.g. "Water Breathing") that was renamed in the actual detailed entry ("Purification") elsewhere on the same page, and the summary table sometimes omits spells that do have full write-ups later on the page. Always verify against the detailed write-up section, not just the summary table.

source_abbreviations.DATP: Dark Alleys & Twisted Paths (this module's source book) — also spelled "DaTP" on some tags found 2026-09-12; confirmed by the project owner to be an SRD-side typo since fixed upstream. Untagged domain sections default to this source per the project owner (2026-09-13) — the SRD only tags domains explicitly when the source is something OTHER than DATP.
source_abbreviations.13ClD / 13ClDS / 13CDS: A separate, unrelated third-party "13th Cleric Domains (and Spells)" product — NOT Dark Alleys & Twisted Paths. This module's own  pack (correctly named/labelled by its original author) is entirely sourced from this product, not DATP.
source_abbreviations.EC: unconfirmed abbreviation seen on this page — meaning not looked up
source_abbreviations.EB: The Escalated Bard (confirmed via a copyright footer on the Bard page) — appears once on the Cleric page too (the "Nature" domain)
source_abbreviations.DPAS: Dark Pacts (13th Age 2e) — the unrelated module by hairyscotsman + the project owner, discussed elsewhere this session. Appears as the source of the cleric "Oracle" domain on this page.

notes: 13-cld-cleric pack: confirmed 0 of its 13 items are DATP-sourced (all trace to 13ClD/13ClDS/13CDS) — correctly excluded from DATP comparison entirely.

dark-alleys-cleric "Domain: Any" group (5 items): exact match to the 5 DATP-tagged entries in all_domains_flat_spell_list (Divine Guidance, Minor Miracle, Remove Fear, Spiritual Weapon, Summon Planetar).

dark-alleys-cleric individual domains (~34, ~100 spells): name-level pass done 2026-09-12, all present and correct once the summary-table staleness above is accounted for. "Ritual" group (Blessed Forge, Ceremony of Blessing): confirmed present on the SRD under a "Cleric Rituals" section.
Module domain "Fire/Volcano" vs SRD's plain "Fire": identical spell content, cosmetic domain-label difference only.
